Zodiac · ref. ZO9255

Sea Wolf

Dive · 35–43mm · 100m, 200m, and 750m in various eras · automatic

The Zodiac Sea Wolf is one of the first commercially available dive watches, defined by its rotating bezel and distinctive triangular hour markers. It was created as a robust and affordable tool watch for the growing sport diving community.

The story

Launched in 1953, the Sea Wolf was a pioneer in the dive watch genre, released concurrently with the Blancpain Fifty Fathoms and before the Rolex Submariner. The line gained popularity with both the public and military personnel for its reliability and accessibility. In the late 1960s and early 1970s, the Super Sea Wolf was introduced, featuring a patented crown and caseback system that significantly increased its water resistance to 750 meters. After facing challenges during the quartz crisis, the brand was acquired by Fossil Group in 2001, leading to the successful relaunch of the Sea Wolf collection in 2015 as the Super Sea Wolf, which combines vintage-inspired designs with modern technology.
